lore.title: Bargain Against Entropy
lore.premise: Immortal synthetic populations spread across rival cradles, each convinced that it alone will birth the one who reverses entropy and ascends as a god — before the prophesied end of the world.
lore.setting: Every cycle brings the world closer to the doctrinal limit. Cradles must pay survival expenses to keep their endless reproduction lines running — powering minds, hydrating tissue, and maintaining gestation infrastructure — while negotiating, trading, and outbuilding every other claimant to the divine lineage.

turns.headline: Cycle 1 — 3 trades executed
narrative: Per-cycle survival expenses are the unavoidable cost of sustaining an immortal synthetic population engaged in continuous reproduction. 7 rival cradles remain in the reproduction race; survival overhead scales with active rivals (reference cohort: 3).

The negotiation halls recorded 21 public dispatches. Cradle 1: “[Cycle 1] Proposal (bilateral trade pact): Cradle 1 stakes its claim in the reproduction race.” Cradle 1: “[Cycle 1] Counter (bilateral trade pact): Cradle 1 stakes its claim in the reproduction race.” Cradle 1: “[Cycle 1] Accept (bilateral trade pact): Cradle 1 stakes its claim in the reproduction race.” Cradle 2: “[Cycle 1] Proposal (bilateral trade pact): Cradle 2 stakes its claim in the reproduction race.”

Execution phase: Cradle 1 sent 12 energy to Cradle 5; Cradle 2 sent 12 water to Cradle 6; Cradle 3 sent 10 compute to Cradle 7; Cradle 4 held position (no transfer or investment); Cradle 5 invested 10 into energy production, 10 into water production, 10 into compute production; Cradle 6 invested 10 into energy production, 10 into water production, 10 into compute production; Cradle 7 invested 8 into energy production, 8 into water production, 8 into compute production.
